note: The frozen model (Tidemark L3, config 7d466291008d) learned only from answers known before 1 Jul 2016. It was scored once, on 2 Oct 2026, on every forecast issued from July 2016 to June 2026 in the two development regions. These years were also looked at before the event, so these scores are slightly optimistic (PREREG.md); the sealed region, opened once on Sat 3 Oct, is the clean test.
